description.value: Urban Gate Specialty Market is a family-owned Persian-inspired boutique grocery store and takeout operation that has served the Tri-Cities area since 2010. The market features an in-house butcher with daily-fresh locally sourced meats, a bakery producing Persian pastries and custom cakes, and a full Persian takeout menu. Cyclists can grab a quick sit-down-quality takeout meal — from koobideh to lamb shank — or stock up on fresh groceries for the road.
